factors.hint: From 0.1 to 2, two decimals at most.

tips.title: Good to know
tips.info: A private challenge only shows to the people invited. You can invite as soon as it is created.
tips.duration: Each week is judged the day after it ends, at 7 a.m. in the challenge's time zone. Until then, everyone can still add or fix their activities.
tips.categories: Think of adding a category besides the time: the distance rewards volume, the elimination progress, the Grand Prix the best weeks, the total elevation gain the climbers.
tips.recap: Everything is fixed at creation except the title and description, which can be changed from the challenge's page.
